Yadyapi sat tv eveti śrutau sacchabdārthaḥ paramātmaiva, tadaikṣatety uttaravākyāt tathāpi
sadekībhāvenedamāsīd itivacanād asya prapañcasyāpi pralaye sattvaṃ siddham eva / Evaṃ taddhedaṃ
tarhy avyākṛtam āsīt tamasaivedam āsīt, āsīd idaṃ tamobhūtam aprajñātam alakṣaṇam ity
ādiśrutismṛtayo'py antocchedaniṣedhikā udāhāryāḥ / Yuktiś cāsadutpāde śaśaśṛṅgādyutpatti-
saṅgabandhamokṣādyanupapattyādirūpā grāhyā / Nanv apetam api ced asti kathaṃ nopalabhyate ?
tatrāha-- saṃsargāc ceti / Asya vikārajātasya svasvakāraṇeṣu prakṛtyādiṣu saṃsargād avibhāgākhyāt
